author: fausset
title: A Commentary, Critical and Explanatory, on the Old and New Testaments: Proverbs
edition: Robert Jamieson, A. R. Fausset and David Brown, Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the Whole Bible (1871); the books from Job to Malachi are Fausset's; CCEL edition

rights.worldwide: to confirm: death dates of every author and editor named (life + 70 years); A. R. Fausset died in 1910

notes: Proverbs 1-31 are CCEL jfb x.xx ii-xxxii, a page a chapter. Every note is kept, in the order printed. A note opens with its bold lemma: a verse number ('7.', '5, 6.' or '10-19.') places it on those verses, and a lemma of words alone ('wisdom') goes on the verses of the note before. The summary that opens a chapter or section ('Pr 1:1-33. After the title...') is on the verses it names. Notes on the same verses are kept together in entries of up to about 350 words. The chapter headings and the introduction to the book are left out.
